paper.title_en: Constraint on anomalous $W^-W^+γ$ coupling in $\ell^\pm γ\slashed{E}$ final state at NLO QCD
paper.abstract_en: We study the anomalous $W^-W^+γ$ triple gauge couplings in the $pp\to \ell^\pmγ\slashed{E}$ channel at $\sqrt{s}=13$~TeV with next-to-leading order QCD corrections. Eight polarization asymmetries of the reconstructed $W$ boson, measured in four disjoint regions of $Δη_{\ellγ}$ and combined with the $m_{Wγ} \ge 1$ TeV distribution, are used to constrain the two CP-even and two CP-odd couplings. The bounds improve only marginally with increasing luminosity, far below the statistical expectation, while they degrade substantially when the systematic uncertainties are relaxed, showing that the sensitivity is systematically limited. A simultaneous four-parameter MCMC fit is performed to obtain marginalized limits. Relative to the CMS $WW+WZ$ combination, our bounds are significantly tighter for the CP-odd coupling $\widetildeλ_γ$ and competitive for $λ_γ$. The CP-odd results are also compared with the electron EDM limit, which constrains both couplings by roughly $2.5$ orders of magnitude beyond the collider reach.
